q.en: How can I contact the clinic?

a.id: Nomor publik 081585532058. Konfirmasikan identitas klinik saat menelepon.
a.en: The published number is 081585532058. Confirm the clinic’s identity when calling.

a.id: Ruko Grand Centro, Jl. Bintaro Permai No.6 Blok A, RT.5/RW.3, Pesanggrahan, Jakarta Selatan 12330. Konfirmasikan petunjuk sebelum berangkat.
a.en: Ruko Grand Centro, Jl. Bintaro Permai No.6 Blok A, RT.5/RW.3, Pesanggrahan, Jakarta Selatan 12330. Confirm directions before travelling.

q.en: What should I prepare before visiting?

a.en: Ask about the appointment time and required documents before visiting.
